common.tagline: Someone to talk to. Anonymous. In Dhivehi or English.
common.listenerNote: Our listeners are trained volunteers who listen. They are not counsellors or therapists and do not give advice.

landing.heroTitle: You don't have to carry it alone.
landing.heroSub: Hiyvaru connects you with a trained volunteer who will simply listen — anonymously, in Dhivehi or English, whenever you need it.
landing.talkDoorTitle: I need someone to talk to
landing.talkDoorDesc: Get matched with a trained listener for a private, anonymous chat. Free, any time. You can delete the whole conversation forever, whenever you like.
landing.helpDoorDesc: Volunteer as a listener. We verify who you are, train you, and support you — so you can be there for someone who needs it.
landing.how1: You stay anonymous — we give you a random name and never show your number to anyone.
landing.how2: You are matched with a trained volunteer listener, in Dhivehi or English.
landing.how3: You can delete your conversation forever, any time.
landing.safetyLine: In an emergency call 119 (Police) or 1677 (Mental Health Helpline) — they are there 24/7.

auth.phoneHint: Any country's number works — e.g. +960, +91, +94, +880. Maldivian numbers can skip the +960.
auth.dobWhy: Hiyvaru is for ages 16 and up. We only keep your birth year — never the full date.
auth.langPref: Which language would you like to talk in?
auth.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code. Enter it below.
auth.errInvalidPhone: That phone number doesn't look right.
auth.errBadCode: That code is wrong or expired.
auth.errCooldown: Please wait a minute before requesting another code.
auth.errAlreadyRegistered: This phone or email already has an account. Try logging in.
auth.errInvalidDate: Please enter a valid date of birth.
auth.errNoAccount: No account found for that phone or email.

under16.title: Hiyvaru is for ages 16 and up
under16.body: We're really glad you reached out — that took courage. Hiyvaru can't offer you an account yet, but you don't have to carry things alone. These lines are free, confidential, and there for you right now:
under16.closing: Please call. People there want to hear from you.

member.breathe: Breathe in… and out. We're finding someone for you.

chat.connected: You're connected. Say hello when you're ready.
chat.timeout: No listener is free right now. Please try again in a little while, or call 1677 — they're there 24/7.
chat.reportPrompt: Tell us what happened. A moderator will review this.
chat.reportSent: Thank you. A moderator will review this.
chat.rateFlag: Something felt wrong — flag for review
chat.keepListener: Match me with this listener again
chat.neverListener: Never match me with this listener again
chat.deleteConfirm: This permanently erases every message. It cannot be undone — not even by us. Delete?
chat.deleteDone: Deleted. This conversation is gone for good.
chat.newAssigned: A member wants to talk. You're connected.
chat.blockedExplicit: Message not sent. Sexual or explicit content is not allowed on Hiyvaru — repeated attempts lead to a permanent ban.
chat.blockedContact: Message not sent. Sharing phone numbers or social media is not allowed — Hiyvaru chats stay anonymous, and repeated attempts lead to a permanent ban.

crisis.title: You matter. Please reach out right now:
crisis.staying: Your listener is staying right here with you.
crisis.escalateConfirm: This will show the member the emergency help card and alert the duty moderator. Continue?
crisis.script1: Stay in the chat. Do not disappear on them.
crisis.script2: Never promise secrecy. Safety comes first.
crisis.script3: Encourage them to call 1677 or 119 themselves — that is the strongest outcome.
crisis.script4: Say: "I'm really glad you told me. Please call 1677 or 119 — I'm staying right here with you."
crisis.riskHint: This conversation may involve someone at risk. Consider the crisis protocol — the Escalate button is there when you need it.
crisis.contactWarning: For everyone's safety, please don't share phone numbers or social media. Hiyvaru chats stay anonymous — sharing contact details can lead to a permanent ban.

apply.title: Become a listener
apply.intro: Listeners are trained volunteers who give their time to listen. Before your first chat we verify your identity (kept strictly private, images deleted after review) and you complete a short training.
apply.selfie: A clear selfie (to match against the ID)
apply.bio: Tell us briefly why you want to listen (optional)
apply.submitted: Application received. Complete the training below — an admin will review your ID. You'll be activated once both are done.
apply.loginFirst: Please create an account or log in first — then return here to apply.
apply.privacyNote: Your ID images are encrypted, visible only to the admin, and permanently deleted the moment a decision is made. We keep only: verified ✓, document type, expiry date.

training.title: Listener training
training.quizNote: You need 100% to pass. You can retry as many times as you like.
training.failed: Not quite — re-read the module and try again.
training.allDone: Training complete! Once your ID is verified you can start listening.

lounge.title: Listener Lounge
lounge.intro: A private space for listeners only. Decompress, ask for support, debrief after heavy chats. What's shared here stays here.
lounge.markDebrief: This is a debrief after a difficult chat (a mentor will follow up)
lounge.debriefNudge: You escalated a chat recently. Please take a moment to debrief in the Lounge — a mentor will check in with you.
